subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> Fixed 柳沟寺 study: writing desk and oil lamp left, paper window left-rear, latched wooden door centered, bed right.
<Picture 2> 孙生 (S1), late-20s scholar, gray-blue robe, same face and costume.
<Picture 3> 山魈 (S2), huge yellow-brown creature, giant claw and sparse long teeth.
<Picture 4> Door, quilt, short knife and claw-mark effects.

summary:
Cold open: Sun Sheng is dragged across the stone floor toward a single solid door that stays latched.

retention_analysis:
Preserve the exact room geometry, centered door, door latch, left desk and right bed from the references. Preserve S1 face and costume. Live-action historical cinema; no subtitles, logos, watermarks, modern objects, extra people, or music.

detailed_description:
Use the supplied keyframe as the exact composition. The centered door is one solid closed wooden panel with zero gap and zero exterior light for every frame; the metal latch never moves. S1 lies on the floor and grips the same quilt that runs continuously from the disordered right bed to the lower door seam. [Shot 1] Near darkness and a low locked camera. [Shot 2] Only one enormous yellow-brown claw reaches under the absolutely closed door, hooks the quilt edge, and retracts; no body or face. [Shot 3] Five dark brown wood-colored claw grooves appear on the door, with no red, blood, or wet shine. End on S1 gasping and a brief dark hold. No curtain motion, no extra people, no door opening.

overall_soundscape:
Black-screen quilt drag, stone scrape, one low nonverbal resonance, wood scratching, S1 terrified breathing. No intelligible dialogue.
